tier_table.status: AM1: pre-registered paid bake-off could not run (platform per-run OpenRouter budget exhausted after the sonnet-4.5 pilot arm, $0.32). Free-model panel chosen from the free models that responded in a 1-call probe; agreement with the 60 completed claude-sonnet-4.5 pilot labels is computed in the analysis (results/tier_table_eval.json).

pair.AM2_note: dots-3 returns deterministic HTTP 400 (provider content rejection) on some harmful rows; B switched to Laguna-S with dots-3 fallback; rows already labelled by dots-3 as B keep that label (rater model recorded per row)

sr.format: full published rubric (no compact format; no bake-off possible)
sr.note: gemini-2.5-flash (pre-registered) unavailable; the free NVIDIA Nemotron-3-super applies the verbatim rubric

tier_table_paid.rule: compact iff kappa(U compact, U full) >= 0.80 AND kappa(U compact, sonnet-4.5 pilot U) >= 0.60 on SL-output rows (original text); else full. flash-lite not tested (budget).
